templates.title: Easel
templates.name: easel
templates.description: Photo manager for Samsung The Frame TVs: send photos from any phone on your Wi-Fi, frame them, and manage what's on each TV.
templates.note: Open http://<server-ip>:3273 afterwards and choose Add TV. Keep the network on host: TV discovery, Wake-on-LAN and LocalSend need it. To stay on a release line, change the image tag to 0.1 instead of latest. See the README.

env.name: PORT
env.label: Web port
env.description: The port the web app listens on (host networking, so it must be free on the server).
